page.overview:
Who is Axem Pink?

Axem Pink is a member and the sole female of the Smithy Gang's Axem Rangers, a major antagonist and boss in Super Mario RPG: Legend of the Seven Stars and its upcoming 2023 remake.

Axem Pink, along with the other Axem Rangers, managed to steal the Star Piece from Mario at Barrel Volcano. The Axem Rangers attempted to flee on their battleship, the Blade, but it was running late and Mario and company managed to catch up. Everyone boarded the Blade where they all engaged in a fight. Eventually, Axem Pink and the other Axem Rangers were defeated.

Axem Pink is the "mage" of the Axem Rangers specializing in healing techniques such as Recover and Mega Recover. However, Axem Pink is also capable of using the dreaded Petal Blast move that can turn all of Mario's party into mushrooms.

Axem Pink is weak against fire techniques meaning Mario's fire moves (especially Super Flame) will work well against her. Axem Pink should also be targeted first as her recovery techniques can be a nuisance as she can keep herself and the other Axem Rangers healed in battle.
